claims.claim: Contribution bullets independently prioritize frequency-domain characterization across GAN architectures/data/resolutions and controlled upsampling investigations, alongside detection methods.
Upsampling analysis trains otherwise matching StyleGAN variants on LSUN bedrooms at256×256 with nearest-neighbor, bilinear and binomial upsampling, comparing mean DCT spectra over10000images.
A separate real/fake experiment uses16000images per class, split10000train/1000validation/5000test per class, comparing ridge regression in pixel versus DCT domains.

caveats: Complete authoritative12-page PDF was scientifically inspected through the browser. Local curl PDF is incomplete and is never treated or hashed as a complete source. Browser-only full-source byte checksum remains unavailable.

The upsampling intervention is controlled within the evaluated StyleGAN/LSUN configuration; the paper’s broader wording about all current GANs is not independently reproduced or generalized to every architecture or modern diffusion model.
The headline real/fake result100% concerns the specified FFHQ/StyleGAN split and simple frequency classifier; it is not a claim of universal real-world accuracy.
Original task labels stay detection; scientific resource/benchmark labels and new task reviews are outside this R3 action.

Independent QC locator correction: five-way source identification appears in Sec4.3, Table3/PDFp8, rather than the original out-of-scope note Sec4.2. This does not affect the assignedR3 recommendation or create a new task-review action.
